subject.title: Feishu auto-reply and `message` tool path bypass `message_sending` / `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sent` plugin hooks

question: Should this issue be split so Feishu outbound hook parity is fixed through the existing `message_sending` bypass track while normal-channel `inbound_claim` broadening is tracked separately?
rationale: The outbound hook gap is source-reproducible and security-relevant, but the `inbound_claim` change alters public plugin claim authority and should not be bundled into a narrow Feishu parity repair by automation.

options.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
options.body: Fix Feishu outbound `message_sending` coverage through the shared exactly-once hook path and open or preserve separate tracking for normal-channel `inbound_claim` semantics.

options.title: Fold into the broader outbound hook issue
options.body: Move the Feishu evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92374 and keep this issue only for the inbound-claim API discussion.

options.title: Design one broader hook semantics PR
options.body: Solve outbound parity and normal inbound claiming together, accepting higher compatibility and security-review cost before any code lands.

recommendation.title: Split outbound parity from inbound claim
recommendation.body: Fix Feishu outbound `message_sending` coverage through the shared exactly-once hook path and open or preserve separate tracking for normal-channel `inbound_claim` semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about plugin hook semantics and claim ordering, and @vincentkoc has recent source history in the relevant hook behavior.
